read.thesis: Strong Q1 with revenue up 10% and ROTCE 23%, but CET1 fell 30bp to 14.3% as RWA rose $60bn; management says Basel III and G-SIB reproposals add about $20bn of G-SIB capital by 2028.

triggers.label: G-SIB surcharge 4.5% → 5.2% by 2028
triggers.quote: The net result is that we need to plan for 5.2% in 2028, a 70 basis point increase from the current 4.5% requirement

triggers.label: RWA up $60bn in quarter
triggers.quote: This quarter's standardized RWA is up $60 billion, primarily driven by the Markets business

triggers.label: 2026 NII and expense guidance held
triggers.quote: The adjusted expense outlook continues to be about $105 billion

guidance.quote: we continue to expect NII ex Markets to be about $95 billion
We now expect total NII to be approximately $103 billion
The adjusted expense outlook continues to be about $105 billion
the Card net charge-off rate continues to be approximately 3.4%

red_flags.label: Cyber risk called largest risk, AI making it worse
red_flags.quote: AI has made it worse, it's made it harder

red_flags.label: Credit cycle expected worse than scenario
red_flags.quote: if there's a credit cycle, I do expect it will be worse than people think relative to the scenario

evasions.quote: I would somewhat discourage you from like annualizing quarterly expense run rate
